scripts.test: pnpm run test:api && pnpm run test:edge && pnpm run test:release-fixture && pnpm run test:mobile
scripts.build: pnpm run check:mobile-config && pnpm run test && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.verify: pnpm run check:mobile-config && pnpm run release:guide-check && pnpm run test && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/mobile exec expo export --platform web && pnpm run release:artifact-check && pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high
scripts.release:preflight: pnpm run release:source-check && pnpm run verify && pnpm exec expo-doctor artifacts/mobile
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run release:rollback-check && pnpm run release:env-check && pnpm run release:preflight && pnpm run release:rollback-check && vercel --prod && pnpm run release:postflight
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
